title: On Repairing the roof before the rains
subtitle: 工程建造 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）
meta: 主题语境：工程建造（科学与技术·工程与建造）　|　核心词汇：repair　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 repair 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1987 the director ① repaired the roof before the rains in public, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② repairs the roof before the rains in silence without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ repair the roof before the rains at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ repaired the roof before the rains before — a line in the poster for August 1981 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Repairing the roof before the rains in public, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ repair the damage with kind words in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Repair the damage with kind words at once and never mention it again.

By 1994 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ repairs the damage with kind words in public every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ repaired the roof before the rains again when nobody else would.

⑩ To repair the roof before the rains, my mother said in 1999, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody repairs the roof before the rains in silence again and somebody must repair the roof before the rains in public all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 修理（一般过去式 repaired the roof before the rains：1987 年导演头一回这样做，当着众人面）
B. v. 修理（一般现在 repairs the roof before the rains：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 修理（不定式 to repair the roof before the rains：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 修理（过去完成时 had repaired the roof before the rains：1981 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 修理（动名词 repairing the roof before the rains 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 弥补（repair the damage with kind words：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去弥补用好话弥补那损失）
G. v. 弥补（repair the damage with kind words：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 修理（后段两处：新来的演员照例 repairs the damage with kind words，而母亲又一次 repaired the roof before the rains）

repair 意为“修理”，自那以后导演一言不发地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 repairs。
repair 意为“修理”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯修理雨季前把屋顶修好”，此处为不定式 to repair the roof before the rains。
repair 意为“修理”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1994 年之前就有人修理过，故用过去完成时 had repaired。

repair 意为“弥补”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去弥补用好话弥补那损失”，should ever 之后用原形 repair the damage with kind words。
repair 意为“弥补”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻弥补用好话弥补那损失（repair the damage with kind words at once），以后再也不要提起。
repair 意为“修理”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例弥补用好话弥补那损失，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 repairs。

repair 意为“修理”，结尾那句是母亲 1999 年的话：要修理雨季前把屋顶修好，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 repair 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1987 the director repaired the roof before the rains in public, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director repairs the roof before the rains in silence whenever the theatre asks.
Repairing the roof before the rains in public, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever repair the damage with kind words in silence, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre repairs the damage with kind words in public every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother repaired the roof before the rains again, and the theatre remembered that half.
